title: June 26, 2018 Austin City Council Discussion
transcript:
AUSTIN CITY COUNCIL 
 
COUNCIL DISCUSSION 
TUESDAY, JUNE 26, 2018 
6:00 PM 
816 CONGRESS AVENUE,  
15TH FLOOR TERRACE 
AUSTIN, TX 78701 
 
Evening Reception 
 
6:00 PM 
Evening reception with City Manager Spencer Cronk, Austin City Council, Austin 
Legislative Delegation, and district office staff for the Austin Congressional 
Delegation. 
 
 
 
A quorum of Council members may be present. No action will be taken. 
 
The City of Austin is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. 
Reasonable modifications and equal access to communications will be provided upon request. 
For assistance, please call 512-974-2210 or TTY users route through 711.
